title: Hub-First Associative Discovery Protocol
objective: Increase opportunity recall and sector breadth by reading broad professional information hubs first, then using AI associative reasoning to form economic hypotheses, and only afterward validating facts and mapping A-share expressions.

architecture.stage2_association: AI links dispersed news into causal economic changes without sector preselection
architecture.stage3_verification: official, primary, company, industry and physical-data sources
architecture.stage4_mapping: value-chain and A-share company expression search
architecture.stage5_underwriting: unchanged V1.9 causal, expectation, valuation, quality, timing and adversarial gates

primaryDiscoveryHubs.historicalProxyRule: When terminal archives are unavailable, public archives from Bloomberg, Reuters and other broad professional publishers may proxy discovery only; every run must be labeled proxy_not_terminal.

discoveryRules: Begin from the broad hub feed or broad time-window digest, not from an industry, ticker, winner, or specialist-source list.
Do not require a predefined primitive query taxonomy to generate the event universe.
State-change primitives may be used only after reading hub items, as an interpretation/checklist tool to understand what changed and what may be connected.
Sector and value-chain labels are assigned after candidate events are discovered.
A hub story is a pointer, not proof; recover the original source or independent primary evidence before underwriting.
Multiple stories may be combined into one hypothesis when they form a coherent causal chain even if no single story names the investment implication.
Search for second-order and cross-industry effects: beneficiary, harmed party, substitute, bottleneck relief, capacity response, margin transfer, supplier/customer spillover and financing effects.
Do not force a stock pick from every event.
associativeReasoningQuestions: What changed relative to the prior state?
Which other hub stories from the same or adjacent weeks become more meaningful when read together?
Where does money, volume, scarcity, bargaining power or utilization move because of this change?
Who benefits directly, who is hurt, and who benefits indirectly one or two links away?
Could the obvious beneficiary already be fully priced while a less-obvious expression is not?
Which A-share companies have verifiable exposure to the changed profit pool?
What evidence would falsify the connection?
verificationPriority: industry associations and physical operating data

frequencyPolicy.goal: More opportunities must come from a broader and smarter discovery universe, not weaker underwriting.

antiOverfitting: No specialist feed may define the initial weekly universe.
Do not add a search category because a later winner belonged to it.
Do not tune association rules on revealed returns from the same historical year.
